# Islands

Islands is a desktop theme inspired by the Islands design of JetBrains. Existing colors and fonts are kept while the layout switches to a minimalist card style that emphasizes clarity and spacing, and the recorded description states that the theme is for desktop use only.

![Islands screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulat-beltone/obsidian-islands-theme/HEAD/images/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Islands"
    author: "Bulat Davletov"
    repo:   "bulat-beltone/obsidian-islands-theme"
    slug:   "islands"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/islands"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bulat-beltone/obsidian-islands-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulat-beltone/obsidian-islands-theme/HEAD/images/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a modern, clean desktop theme inspired by JetBrains' Islands design. Keep existing colors and fonts while switching to a minimalist card-style layout that emphasizes clarity and spacing. Use on desktop only."
}
```
